_comment: Copy this to provision.json, fill it in, and put it in the same folder as
WhatsAppPrinter-Setup.exe. Setup copies it to C:\ProgramData\WAPrinter and
the agent applies it on first start, then deletes it.
It holds the access token in plain text. Keep it on a USB stick or a share
you control, and never commit it -- this repository is public.
Every key is optional; anything left out keeps its existing value.
To reconfigure a machine that is already running: waprinter provision FILE
